principle: Source locale and output locale are separate. A worry found in Japanese can enrich the shared canonical map, then be written in Korean, English, or any later output language.

locales.label: Korean
collectionMethods: Google and Naver autocomplete patterns
Generalized Korean community worry phrases
Korean public institutions, law, and official guidance
sourceSignals: 입시, 취업, 가족 의무, 연애 불안, 직장 관계
빠른 비교 문화와 생애 일정 압박
한국 법령과 공공기관 자료가 필요한 현실 문제
canonicalUse: Keep Korean as the first canonical writing language for now.
Use Korean source phrases to define the first taxonomy and emotional tags.
safetyRules: Do not store personal posts or identifiable stories.
Generalize community expressions before they become search phrases.

locales.label: English
collectionMethods: Google autocomplete patterns
Reddit-style question pattern counts without raw post storage
Research, public health, institutional, and philosophy sources
sourceSignals: self-improvement, therapy language, boundaries, burnout, loneliness
AI, free speech, identity, fairness, and public controversy
search-friendly worry forms such as 'why do I', 'should I', 'is it normal'
canonicalUse: Add English search doors to the same canonical nodes.
Use English-origin worries to discover missing universal nodes.
safetyRules: Do not store Reddit titles or bodies as page copy.
Store only generalized patterns, counts, and rewritten user doors.

locales.label: Japanese
collectionMethods: Google and Yahoo Japan autocomplete patterns
Generalized public Q&A worry phrases
Japanese official institutions and mental-health/public-life resources
Japanese and East Asian thinkers where source context is relevant
sourceSignals: ikigai, loneliness, social pressure, school refusal, overwork, family distance
quiet worries that may not appear in the same form in Korean or English
canonicalUse: Map Japanese worry phrases to existing Korean/English nodes first.
Promote repeated unmatched Japanese patterns into candidate clusters.
Do not make Japanese-output pages until enough original Japanese phrasing is curated.
safetyRules: Keep cultural context as a signal, not a stereotype.

locales.label: Chinese

canonicalUse: Use Chinese-source signals to deepen family, study, work, duty, and meaning nodes.

locales.label: Spanish

Public health and family/labor institution sources
Spanish-language philosophy and literature references where relevant
